title: ​Large-scale refactors with Agents, Robert Brennan, CEO of OpenHands
description:
Today's agents are best at small, atomic coding tasks. Much larger tasks--like major refactors and breaking dependency updates--are highly automatable but hard to one-shot.

In this session, we'll discuss patterns for orchestrating large-scale code changes with swarms of agents and a human in the loop.

Robert Brennan is the CEO of OpenHands, the leading open source coding agent. He's spent the last decade making open source developer tools, with a focus on coding agents, Kubernetes, and REST APIs. Before that, he worked on natural language processing as a Senior SWE at Google.
